arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transactions_over_500_prepaid FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON c.id = t.card_id WHERE c.card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)' AND t.amount_usd_cents > 50000
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions above $500 made on prepaid debit cards, whether or not they carry a fraud label.
assumptions: 'Over $500' means amount_usd_cents > 50000, so exactly $500.00 is excluded.
The count covers all transactions in the data (2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31), including those with no fraud label.
